channel.description: Latest articles from The Blacksphere (Kevin Jackson) – Bias and Credibility (theblacksphere.net)

item.title: 2026 Will Get Worse for Democrats
item.description: One year left on Earth—confirmed doom. Would Democrats finally ditch the virtue-signaling jet-set life and go full YOLO, or cling to routines while preaching equality from their mansions? A comedic look at how AOC, Al Gore, and the left's luminaries might hilariously fumble the end times.

item.title: How the Cartel Takedown Impacts Democrat Fundraising
item.description: For decades, politicians staged a theatrical “war on drugs” while cartels expanded into multinational empires. Now, with terrorists’ rules applied to traffickers, the game has changed and suddenly the silence in Washington feels very loud.

item.title: Will Democrats Develop a Love of Trump?
item.description: Donald Trump’s success is forcing an ideological reckoning the Left can’t avoid. By 2026, denial collapses, excuses soften, and former enemies quietly confess what results make undeniable.

item.title: Democrats’ Prophet of Perpetual Panic Has Died
item.description: He predicted mass starvation, societal collapse, and the end of civilization as we know it. What he didn’t predict? Being wrong. Over. And over. And somehow still invited back to the party.

item.title: When a Trump Punchline Changed Diplomacy
item.description: A single line from Donald Trump about Pearl Harbor did something diplomats couldn’t manage in eighty years. It didn’t reopen wounds. It quietly stitched one shut.

item.title: The Greatest Political Mistake Democrats Ever Made
item.description: Democrats thought Donald Trump would be the easiest opponent in modern history. Instead, they created a political juggernaut who reshaped the electorate. The real tragedy for them is not losing to Trump, but much bigger...

item.title: The Expert Class Strikes Out Again
item.description: For decades we’ve been told to trust the experts. Yet when reality arrives, their predictions collapse like a cheap lawn chair, leaving the rest of us to wonder why we ever listened.

item.title: Good Riddance to Leftism: If Democrats Are Winning Everywhere, Prove It
item.description: The progressive movement looks less like a political juggernaut and more like a touring exhibit of unpopular ideas. If Leftism is truly ascendant, someone should show the scoreboard.

item.title: The Secret Service Problem Trump Created
item.description: One Secret Service agent says Donald Trump “ruined” him for the job. Not with demands or arrogance, but with something Washington rarely practices anymore: remembering the people who stand quietly behind power.

item.title: Temporary Victories: The Democrats’ Favorite Courtroom Illusion
item.description: For nearly a decade Democrats have perfected a legal strategy that looks impressive on cable news but ages about as well as milk in Phoenix sunlight. The formula is simple: sue Trump, celebrate the injunction, declare victory, and then quietly disappear when the Supreme Court rewrites the ending.
